timeBudget.method: Start-of-tick living-person occupancy; exclusive categories, actual endings, sampled batch-step opportunities. Critical exposure uses fixed bodily thresholds, not anticipatory thirst. Failure recovery is idle within 80 ticks of failure/interruption. Aborted travel may have achieved partial useful work; it is not automatically wasted time. Open work spells are right-censored.
